auth.registration: POST /public/v1/auth/register returns the bearer token. Send it on POST /public/v1/onboarding/start with the same email; no separate integration identity is required.

description: ame — study, sweetened. An agent-friendly learning API with one owner-scoped learner model.
name: ame
principles: Agents and people use the same authenticated learner API.
Every learning resource is scoped to the bearer token's learner.
The API never sends email; email is an account identifier in self-host mode.
Use idempotencyKey when starting a journey.

tools.description: Register a learner account and receive the bearer session used by the unified learning API. Self-host mode does not send email.
tools.name: identity.register

tools.description: Authenticate an existing learner account and receive the bearer session used by the unified learning API.
tools.name: identity.login

tools.description: Read AME's public learning rules, user stories, evidence boundary, and fixture-simulation policy before mutating learner state.
tools.name: learning.contract.get

tools.description: List reviewed native journeys that may be selected through the same onboarding contract as a freeform prompt. Each entry includes structured source links, licenses, optional locators or source versions, and an explicit content-review record.
tools.name: learning.catalog.list

tools.description: Preview the promise, objectives, and first activity for a learner's prompt without creating state.
tools.name: learning.preview

tools.description: Bootstrap the first owner-scoped journey. After register or login, send that learner's bearer token and the matching email; unauthenticated start is only for a previously unknown email.
tools.name: learning.start

tools.description: List the authenticated learner's journeys and the next activity for each.
tools.name: learning.journey.list

tools.description: Read one authenticated learner's intent, objectives, activities, evidence, and the same evidence-backed recommendation returned to the browser. The recommendation includes objectiveId and server-derived evidenceIds.
tools.name: learning.journey.get

tools.description: Create an empty, owner-scoped draft course from the learner brief and approved citation certificates. This never inserts generic starter material; author outcomes, modules, instruction, checks, assessment/task work, validate, then publish.
tools.name: learning.course.create

tools.description: Create a new empty draft revision for an owned journey after its prior revision is published or retired. Supply a complete, source-grounded brief, then author a new revision-scoped graph; AME never mutates a published course graph in place.
tools.name: learning.course.revision.create

tools.description: Read an owned revision's lifecycle status, persisted brief, source certificates, server validation diagnostics, review record, and publication timestamp before editing or retrying a transition.
tools.name: learning.course.revision.get

tools.description: Clone a published revision into a new private draft with fresh objectives, modules, activities, assessments, and assessment-item links. It preserves the published learner graph until the fork separately validates, reviews, and publishes.
tools.name: learning.course.revision.fork

tools.description: Append a measurable outcome to the active draft revision before linking instructional activities, formative checks, or mastery work to it.
tools.name: learning.course.objective.create

tools.description: Run the server-side course validator. It reports stable blocking diagnostics for missing source grounding, module instruction/example coverage, formative rationale and learner explanation feedback, assessment/task mastery coverage, rubrics, and review state.
tools.name: learning.course.revision.validate

tools.description: Move a valid owned draft course revision to review, recording the approval metadata after the server-side validator passes. Review must include non-empty reviewer, decision=approved, and notes.
tools.name: learning.course.revision.review

tools.description: Publish a reviewed course revision. This is the only agent-facing publication command for a course; it revalidates atomically and exposes reviewed activities only if no blocking diagnostic remains.
tools.name: learning.course.revision.publish

tools.description: Append a named chapter to the active draft revision. Create chapters before the activities they contain; AME assigns the next stable chapter order within that revision.
tools.name: learning.course.chapter.create

tools.description: Append an objective-linked draft course activity. Use ready only for the learner's next startable activity and proposed for later ordered activities. It remains private until course-level validation, review, and publication succeed. A practice activity can receive a published assessment; an application activity can receive a reviewed rubric and task submission.
tools.name: learning.course.activity.create

tools.description: Move an owned draft-revision activity into review. This is required before publication; callers cannot create learner-visible activities directly.
tools.name: learning.course.activity.review

tools.description: Start an activity in an owned journey.
tools.name: learning.activity.start

tools.description: Import bounded learner-owned source text as an immutable SHA-256 snapshot. URL imports accept public HTTPS only; document and local-file imports accept agent-supplied text and never read server filesystem paths.

content.description: Required for document and local_file; ignored for URL.

tools.name: learning.source.import

tools.description: Inspect completed and failed source import runs for the authenticated learner, including stable failure codes.
tools.name: learning.source.import.list

tools.description: List the authenticated learner's immutable source snapshots.
tools.name: learning.source.snapshot.list

tools.description: Read one authenticated learner's immutable source snapshot and digest.
tools.name: learning.source.snapshot.get

tools.description: Certify an exact byte range in an immutable source snapshot with grounding and licensing review metadata.
tools.name: learning.citation.create

tools.description: Inspect learner-owned citation certificates and their immutable snapshot anchors.
tools.name: learning.citation.list

tools.description: Read one learner-owned citation certificate, grounding decision, and licensing metadata.
tools.name: learning.citation.get

tools.description: Create an idempotent private learner note anchored to a journey or an exact activity content version.
tools.name: learning.note.create

tools.description: Resume private notes for an owned journey or activity, preserving their original content-version anchors.
tools.name: learning.note.list

tools.description: Edit a private note using its revision for optimistic concurrency.
tools.name: learning.note.update

tools.description: Permanently delete one private learner note.
tools.name: learning.note.delete

tools.description: Request another explanation, example, or difficulty variant through the existing generation lifecycle without creating mastery evidence.
tools.name: learning.variant.request

tools.description: Inspect pending, failed, review-required, and available variants for an owned activity.
tools.name: learning.variant.list

tools.description: Attach reviewed, citation-certified content after the linked generation run is published.
tools.name: learning.variant.publish

tools.description: Export an owned journey and learner history as a versioned, checksummed application manifest that preserves its immutable learner or fixture origin.
tools.name: learning.portability.export

tools.description: Validate and idempotently restore a same-owner journey manifest, reporting tampering and conflicts explicitly.
tools.name: learning.portability.import

tools.description: Read owner-only event-derived retention and progress metrics with explicit timezone, numerators, denominators, and definitions.
tools.name: learning.analytics.get

tools.description: Finish a learning session and persist completion responses. This is not mastery evidence: record mastery only from a graded assessment attempt or reviewed task submission.
tools.name: learning.session.finish

tools.description: Read one authenticated learner's activity session so an external agent can resume the same state as the browser.
tools.name: learning.session.get

tools.description: Read an owned activity's immutable published payload, version, rubric, and status without starting or reopening a learner session. Use this to review completed work.
tools.name: learning.activity.content.get

tools.description: Start a submission for an application task at its immutable content version. The response is not evidence until evaluation reaches a reviewed state.
tools.name: learning.task.submission.start

tools.description: Submit an application-task response for evaluation. It may become pending review rather than immediately producing a score.
tools.name: learning.task.submission.submit

tools.description: Read the learner's task submission status, score, and reviewer or agent feedback.
tools.name: learning.task.submission.get

tools.description: Replace an uncompleted explanation or worked example with reviewed, source-backed content from a published learning.activity.content.compose generation run.

content.description: The content type must match the activity kind: explanation uses heading, body, key_points; worked_example uses heading, prompt, steps, reflection. Text and list items must be non-empty strings.

tools.name: learning.activity.content.author

tools.description: Attach a structured scoring rubric to a task/application activity from a published learning.activity.rubric.compose generation run. Criteria and points guide manual/agent review; learners see the criteria. Provenance is mandatory.

rubric.description: Structured rubric: version, criteria[] (each id, objectiveId, description, maxPoints>=1, required), optional passingScore 0..1.

tools.name: learning.activity.rubric.author

tools.description: Create a learner-owned versioned question from a published question.compose generation run; provenance is mandatory. For a course formative check, set both rationale and explanation: explanation is the learner-facing correct-answer feedback (there is no feedback field).

explanation.description: Learner-facing correct-answer feedback; required alongside rationale for a publishable formative check.

rationale.description: Why this question assesses the linked objective; required alongside explanation for a publishable formative check.

tools.name: learning.question.create

tools.description: Read one exact learner-owned question version for reproducible assessment history.
tools.name: learning.question.get

tools.description: Create the next immutable question version from a published question.compose generation run.
tools.name: learning.question.revise

tools.description: Compose approved immutable question versions into a practice or graded assessment attached to the active draft revision. From a question response, use questionId (logical ID) and version (integer) for each item; do not use id, which is the immutable version UUID.
tools.name: learning.assessment.create

tools.description: Read one learner-owned assessment and its exact question-version membership.
tools.name: learning.assessment.get

tools.description: Discover the learner-owned assessment attached to an activity before starting it.
tools.name: learning.assessment.get_for_activity

tools.description: Start or resume an attempt against one immutable assessment version.
tools.name: learning.attempt.start

tools.description: Save one answer while preserving assessment item and question version identity. Response envelopes are question-kind specific: multiple choice uses {option_id: option-id}; true/false, short answer, and numeric use {value: boolean|string|number}. Numeric accepts a JSON number or numeric string; do not use {answer: ...}.

response.description: multiple_choice: {option_id: string}; true_false, short_answer, numeric: {value: boolean|string|number}; numeric accepts a JSON number or numeric string.

tools.name: learning.attempt.answer

tools.description: Finish an attempt, grade deterministic items, and return assessmentMode plus reviewStatus (complete or pending) so practice results cannot be mistaken for an exam result.
tools.name: learning.attempt.finish

tools.description: Read an owned attempt and its saved responses/result.
tools.name: learning.attempt.get

tools.description: Read all assessment attempts in one learner-owned journey, including durable results.
tools.name: learning.attempt.history

tools.description: Record rebuildable mastery evidence from a completed learner attempt.
tools.name: learning.progress.evidence

tools.description: Read evidence-derived mastery and confidence for one objective.
tools.name: learning.progress.snapshot

tools.description: Select the weakest objective from an explicit journey objective set.
tools.name: learning.progress.recommend

tools.description: Record an idempotent qualifying learning day from a completed attempt event (attempt:<id>); the day must match the attempt's graded timestamp in the supplied IANA learner timezone.
tools.name: learning.progress.streak.record

tools.description: Read qualifying learning days for one owned journey.
tools.name: learning.progress.streak.list

tools.description: Read the ordered activity, assessment, evidence, deep-dive, and streak history for one owned journey.
tools.name: learning.progress.timeline

tools.description: Create a source-backed deep dive from a published deep_dive.create generation run, linked to matching owned evidence. Unreviewed content is stored for review but is not learner-readable until approved.

reviewStatus.description: Content is returned by learner reads only when approved.

tools.name: learning.deep_dive.create

tools.description: Discover the approved source-backed deep dive attached to an activity. Draft and review content is not returned.
tools.name: learning.deep_dive.get_for_activity

tools.description: Read one approved source-backed deep dive owned by the learner; draft and review content is not returned.
tools.name: learning.deep_dive.get

tools.description: Start or resume an owner-scoped provider generation run with an idempotent retry key.
tools.name: learning.generation.start

tools.description: Read the status, provider, failure detail, and content version of an owned generation run.
tools.name: learning.generation.get

tools.description: Advance an owned generation run or record a provider failure; failed runs cannot be published. The successful path is requested -> running -> review_required -> published; do not skip states. A failure may be recorded from a nonterminal state.
tools.name: learning.generation.transition

tools.description: Create a new immutable revision from a rejected learner submission while preserving its task, objective, and content-version lineage.
tools.name: learning.task.revise
